title: Artifact
description: Top-level persisted artifact at `runs/<session_id>/` (§5.10, Pass 1 rows #96, #154; R2). Bundles the session configuration, the canonical_transcript (append-only ordered log), and either a synthesis (when the session finalized) or a termination_artifact (otherwise) — exactly one of the two. Cumulative usage and unresolved disagreements are surfaced at the top level for indexability. Strict `(round, turn_index)` ordering of canonical_transcript entries is a producer/consumer invariant (N7); JSON Schema cannot fully enforce ordering — a conforming runtime MUST enforce it on read.

schema_version.description: SemVer of this Artifact schema (§5.1). Pass 4 schemas are `1.0.0`. A consumer MUST refuse to load an artifact whose MAJOR version it does not understand and MUST consult §5.1's migration policy.

config.description: The session configuration that produced this run.

canonical_transcript.description: Append-only ordered log of every message produced during the session (§2.4, §4.10 invariant 9). Sorted by `(round, turn_index)` in execution order. The first message is the `problem_statement`; the last is either the `synthesis` or, on terminate paths, the final `coordination_turn` (or `panel_contraction`) before the session ended.

outcome.description: Exactly one of: `synthesis` (the session finalized) or `termination` (the session ended without a synthesis). The discriminator is `kind`.

synthesis_message_id.description: Id of the synthesis Message inside canonical_transcript. The synthesis content is in that message; this field is a pointer for fast lookup.

cumulative_usage.description: Cumulative token/cost usage across every provider invocation in the session.

cumulative_unresolved.description: Cumulative list of unresolved disagreements collected across the session. Mirrors the final synthesis.unresolved_disagreements (on finalize) or termination_artifact.unresolved_disagreements (on terminate).

transcript_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) of the canonical_transcript at session end, computed using the JCS-canonicalization rule of §7.7. Pass 6 promoted this from TerminationArtifact-only (Pass 4) to top-level Artifact: every persisted session has a digest, regardless of outcome. When `outcome.kind = termination`, this value MUST equal `outcome.termination_artifact.transcript_digest`. When `outcome.kind = synthesis`, this is the only digest field present in the artifact.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the session entered `init`.

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the session reached `persist` (after either synthesis append or termination_artifact production).
